opportunity.title: Survey-Based Research Platform and Platform Management Tool (RFI)
opportunity.description: The VA Acquisition Academy needs a Software as a Service survey-based research platform and platform management tool to securely collect responses to a competency survey it is piloting for acquisition human capital planning. Required: software subscriptions, maintenance and support. Period of performance is a 12-month base plus four 12-month options. Respondents provide a rough order of magnitude price against the salient characteristics by email by Oct 20, 2026.

rationale.point: Opportunity is an RFI (market research) not a solicitation; responding requires minimal resources but yields no contract award.
Company has no federal past performance and only state-level data-entry/migration experience, which does not align with SaaS survey platform development and management.
Award history shows median top awards near $100M, indicating resulting contracts likely exceed company capacity (4 staff, no clearance, no SOC 2, Arizona-only staffing).
No small-business set-aside on this RFI; future solicitations may include set-asides but current response only informs VA requirements.

risks: Diverting limited staff effort to an RFI with no near-term revenue potential
Exposing capability gaps (no FedRAMP, no clearance, no relevant past performance) that could weaken future proposals
Large contract sizes in this NAICS/agency suggest prime contracts unsuitable for a 4-person firm without teaming
nextSteps: Submit a brief RFI response only if it can be prepared in <40 hours, emphasizing interest in future small-business set-aside work
Track VA solicitations under NAICS 541519 for set-aside opportunities matching data-migration or survey-support services
Pursue first federal contract via GSA Schedule, SEWP, or subcontracting to build relevant past performance
Assess teaming with larger firms holding FedRAMP authorizations for survey-platform work
